title: DegenFeed: Crypto Social Feed
shortDescription: Unified feed for Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky & more — decentralized social, one scroll.
fullDescription:
DegenFeed brings together all your decentralized social networks in one place. Follow what matters across Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, and RSS — all from a single unified feed.

UNIFIED FEED
Aggregate posts from every major decentralized social protocol into one scrollable timeline. No more switching between apps.

CROSS-PROTOCOL COMPOSER
Write once, publish everywhere. Compose a post and syndicate it across all your connected networks simultaneously.

REAL-TIME NOTIFICATIONS
Get push notifications for mentions, replies, and likes across every network you use.

DISCOVER
Find trending content and creators across the decentralized web. See what's gaining traction on Nostr, Farcaster, Lens, and more.

CRYPTO-NATIVE WALLET INTEGRATION
Connect your Solana or EVM wallet to verify your on-chain identity. Show your NFTs, tokens, and degen cred right on your profile.

PRIVACY FIRST
No central server stores your data. Your keys remain on your device. End-to-end, you control your identity and content.

CUSTOM FEEDS
Build custom feeds from any combination of protocols, topics, and creators. Save and switch between feeds instantly.

DegenFeed is the essential client for the decentralized social web. Whether you're a degen trader, a crypto native, or just tired of walled gardens, DegenFeed puts you back in control.

Permissions:
- Push Notifications: To alert you of new mentions, replies, and likes
- Internet: Required to connect to decentralized relays and hubs
